title: How do I use the Web Service API?
intent: This article provides an overview of the EUSurvey Web Service API for programmatic access.
short_answer: EUSurvey provides a REST-like Web Service API for programmatic access to surveys and contributions. The API supports operations like publishing/unpublishing surveys, managing tokens, exporting results, and retrieving survey metadata. Authentication uses HTTP Basic Auth with a valid EUSurvey login and password.
prerequisites: Valid EUSurvey user account with API access
Knowledge of the survey UID or shortname
procedure: Authenticate using HTTP Basic Auth (login and password in the request).
Call the desired endpoint with appropriate parameters.
Handle the response (XML or JSON format depending on endpoint).
important_conditions: The API uses HTTP Basic Auth for authentication.
Rate limiting applies: maximum requests per day (default: 100, configurable via webservice.maxrequestsperday).
Available operations include: publish, unpublish, archive, restore, delete surveys; create/activate/deactivate tokens; export results (XML, PDF); get survey metadata and status.
Results can be exported with date filters.
Token management: create token lists, create individual tokens, activate/deactivate tokens.
The API returns XML responses for most endpoints.
Async operations (exports) return a task ID that can be polled for completion.
No OpenAPI/Swagger specification was found in the repository.
troubleshooting: Authentication failed: Verify login credentials are correct.
Rate limit exceeded: Wait or contact admin to increase the limit.
Survey not found: Verify the survey UID or shortname.
